plain_statement.zh: B13 的双侧 Vaughan 余项归约

brief.zh: 保持每个充分大偶数的量词。第一带把 Mangoldt 因子换为阈值 n^(1/96) 的截断卷积长项。第三带只在右侧余因子超过 floor(n^(33/64)) 时作阈值 n^(1/256) 的对应替换。用两侧 Type-I 散项的 o(n) 界证明两向归约。
brief.en: Keep the quantifier over sufficiently large even n. Replace the first-band Mangoldt factor by the long convolution at n^(1/96). Apply the corresponding n^(1/256) expansion in the third band for right cofactors above floor(n^(33/64)). Bound the discarded Type-I terms by o(n) in both directions.
